scripts.start: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/start-all.py; else python3 scripts/start-all.py; fi
scripts.dev: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/start-all.py; else python3 scripts/start-all.py; fi
scripts.dev:all: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/start-all.py; else python3 scripts/start-all.py; fi
scripts.build:bin: mkdir -p bin && go build -o bin/writer ./apps/api/cmd/writer && go build -o bin/api ./apps/api/cmd/api
